texts.li: [theirLowtech] {X_nameFull} is touring the region. Twenty years ago {X_nameDef} was a village healer; now there are songs about {X_objective}, and people walk for days to be seen. {X_nameDef} is in {PLACE} this week and will move on soon.\n\nThey say {X_nameDef} once put back a hand that was gone, and cured a fever no other healer could name. The line outside {X_possessive} door in {PLACE} starts before dawn.

[theirHightech] {X_nameFull}, the surgeon, is touring the region with a van full of equipment and a waiting list longer than the road. {X_nameDef} is in {PLACE} this week and will move on soon.\n\nThey say {X_nameDef} has rebuilt a hand that was gone and cured things other doctors had given up on. Some of that may even be true.

summaries.li: {X_nameDef} could be invited to the colony for a day, to treat {A_nameDef} and teach the colony's own doctor. It costs silver, and the chance won't come again soon.
[invited] {X_nameDef} is on the way to the colony.

texts.li: [!remembered] {X_nameDef}'s assistant has sent word that the healer could stop at the colony on the way to the next town, for {COUNT} silver. {A_nameDef} has lived with {A_possessive} condition a long time, and {X_nameDef} might be able to do something about it.\n\n{B_nameDef} would give a lot to watch {X_nameDef} work.

[remembered] {X_nameDef} has heard how the colony helped {FACTION} when times were hard, and has sent word: the healer will stop at the colony on the way to the next town, for {COUNT} silver, half what others pay. {A_nameDef} has lived with {A_possessive} condition a long time.\n\n{B_nameDef} would give a lot to watch {X_nameDef} work.

li.label: Invite {X_objective} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: The assistant's rider takes the fee back to {PLACE}. {X_nameDef} will come within a few days.

li.label: Not now
li.outcome: The colony sends its regrets. {X_nameDef} will be gone from the region soon.

texts.li: [!nothingToMend,taught] {X_nameDef} arrived at noon, looked at {A_nameDef} for a long time without saying anything, and asked for hot water and the colony's best light. By evening it was done. {ITEM}\n\n{B_nameDef} watched every step and asked a hundred questions, and {X_nameDef} answered most of them.

[!nothingToMend,!taught] {X_nameDef} arrived at noon, looked at {A_nameDef} for a long time without saying anything, and asked for hot water and the colony's best light. By evening it was done. {ITEM}

[nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} arrived at noon and looked {A_nameDef} over carefully, twice, then said there was nothing left that needed a healer's hands. The colony's silver was handed back at the gate.

[!nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} left the colony at dawn for the next town, with the colony's silver and its thanks. {A_nameDef} walked the healer to the edge of the colony's land and stood there a while after.
[nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} left the colony at dawn for the next town. Whatever ailed {A_nameDef} had mended on its own, and the colony will take that.

li.chronicle: {X_nameDef}, the famous healer, came to the colony.

texts.li: {X_nameDef} has left the region, and the crowds that followed the healer from town to town have gone home. In the towns they are already arguing over which of the cures really happened.

li.chronicle: {X_nameDef}, the famous healer, passed through the region.

texts.li: Every few years the herds of the region move together, and this is one of those years. The ground shakes at dusk, the birds follow the dust, and the hunters of {FACTION} have come out of {PLACE} in force.\n\nThere will be meat for anyone who wants it, and trouble for anyone who gets in the way.

[fall] The herds are going south ahead of the cold, all of them at once. From the colony's wall the dust can be seen a day before the animals, and {FACTION}'s hunters are already camped along the valleys out of {PLACE}.
[spring] The herds are coming back north with the new grass, so many that the far hills seem to move. The hunters of {FACTION} have come out of {PLACE} to meet them, their winter stores nearly gone.

summaries.li: Herds pass the colony far more often, and rare beasts with them. {FACTION}'s hunters may ask to hunt on the colony's land.

texts.li: A party of hunters from {PLACE} has asked to follow the herds across the colony's land. They will keep clear of the fields and the buildings, they say. They would pay {COUNT} silver for the right, or take it as a favor between neighbors.\n\n{A_nameDef} thinks they know what they're doing.

li.label: Let them hunt
li.outcome: The party thanks the colony and goes after the herds. For days afterward their horns can be heard at dawn.

li.label: Let them hunt, for {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: Their headman pays without arguing, and the party goes after the herds.
li.deed: charged {FACTION}'s hunters to cross its land

li.label: Keep them off the land
li.outcome: The hunters are told to go around. They do, the long way.

texts.li: [allowed] The herds have passed, and the hunters of {FACTION} have gone home with full packs. Their horn-blower sounded three long notes as they passed the colony, which among hunters means thanks.
[!allowed] The herds have passed, and the land around the colony is quiet again: trampled in places, greener in others. They'll be back in a few years.

li.chronicle: The great herds passed through the region.

texts.li: Something has driven the strange beasts of the far country into the region: animals the old hunters of {FACTION} only know from stories, moving in loose bands and eating anything green.\n\nSome are harmless, and some very much aren't. The hunters of {PLACE} are staying close to home until they know which are which.

[winter] The cold has driven the strange beasts of the far country down out of the high places: animals nobody in {PLACE} has a name for, moving in loose bands through the snow.\n\nOne of them stood at the edge of {PLACE}'s fields all yesterday, watching the houses, and then walked away.

summaries.li: Strange creatures turn up far more often, with herds behind them. A skilled handler may win one over; a careless one may regret trying.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} found tracks by the water this morning that don't match anything in the colony's books, and has been out sketching them since.
The strange beasts have drifted back toward the far country, or wherever they came from. The hunters of {FACTION} are out again, and the stories about this season are getting bigger by the day.

li.chronicle: The strange herds left the region.

texts.li: The ley lines are restless. Mages in {PLACE} report spells going wrong and spells going far too right, and on clear nights the sky is streaked with colors nobody can name.\n\n{FACTION} have shut their mage towers until it passes. Anyone with the gift will feel it.

[winter] The winter nights have turned strange. The sky over the region burns green and violet after dark, mages in {PLACE} wake up with frost on the inside of their windows, and {FACTION} have shut their mage towers until it passes.\n\nEvery mage in the region is sleeping badly, and dreaming in the same colors.

summaries.li: Shards fall from the sky more often, and the colony's mages may learn more in these weeks than in a year, if they dare to study the surge.

texts.li: Since the sky turned, {A_nameDef} has hardly slept, and now wants to spend a few nights out at the old stones on the hill, where the ley lines cross, to see what the surge can teach.\n\nIt could be a year's study in a week. The mages of {PLACE} say it could also go badly.

li.label: Let {A_objective} study it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} comes back from the stones after three nights, red-eyed and talking too fast, with a notebook full of diagrams that make the others' eyes ache.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} comes back from the stones pale and quiet, and won't say what happened out there. The notebook is full, though.

li.label: Not this time
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} stays at the colony, and spends the nights at the window watching the sky.

texts.li: The sky has gone back to its usual colors, and the mages of {PLACE} have opened their towers again. Whatever stirred the ley lines has gone still, and the mages are already arguing about what it was.

li.chronicle: A season of wild magic passed.
